The plan invokes the 'audited 28% fire rate' for the gate and '13/20 actionable T3 findings' but does not report a corpus-replay priority-percentile analysis at 0.90 for either criterion, leaving the threshold choice as an unverified capability assertion ('0.90 is safe/conservative').
